mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate environment compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the cost of capital remains suppressed.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate environments (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 245.0 indicates accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as bond yields rise and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL above 245.0 fails to produce negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: The joint growth in HOUST and RSAFS (both above their 3-month moving averages) fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy recovers and equity valuations improve.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (INDPRO < 100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as recession fears intensify and corporate earnings decline.
failure_condition: INDPRO below 100 fails to produce negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 16800.0 billion) indicates robust economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings growth is sustained.
failure_condition: GDPC1 above 16800.0 fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll growth exceeding 0.5% (PAYEMS growth > 0.5%) signals a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer spending and corporate hiring boost economic activity.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth above 0.5% fails to produce positive 5-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 245.0) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) indicate a 'stagflationary' environment where the Fed is hesitant to raise rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as both inflation and growth concerns weigh on equity valuations.
failure_condition: The joint condition of CPIAUCSL > 245.0 and FEDFUNDS < 1.5% fails to produce negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.
